certifications.name: Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)®
certifications.description: PMI's foundational project management credential, covering predictive, agile, and hybrid approaches across the full project lifecycle: scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, communication, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management, grounded in PMBOK 6th and 7th Edition.

certifications.name: Certified Data Science Specialist (CDSS)
certifications.description: Specialist-level data science credential covering the end-to-end analytics workflow: data preparation and wrangling, exploratory and diagnostic analysis, machine learning model development, and translating results into decisions stakeholders can act on.

certifications.name: Power BI Data Analyst
certifications.description: Microsoft's data analyst credential for Power BI: preparing and modelling data, writing DAX measures, designing report visuals, and managing deployment and workspace access.

certifications.name: Salesforce Certified Tableau Data Analyst
certifications.description: Salesforce's analyst credential for Tableau, covering connecting and preparing data, building calculations, designing dashboards that hold up under real questions, and sharing work through Tableau Cloud and Server.

certifications.name: Machine Learning Professional Certification
certifications.description: Professional-level examination covering applied machine learning in RapidMiner: building and scoring predictive models, validating them honestly, and reading what the results actually say about the data.

certifications.name: Data Engineering Professional Certification
certifications.description: Professional-level examination covering the data preparation work that precedes modelling: accessing sources, reshaping and combining data sets, and handling the routine transformations analysis depends on.
